title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton (SIBE): S, I and the catalyst layer (B) replicate on fresh seed 9; at the starvation fork vesicles shrink ~80% but 3 of 4 are still alive 300 t later, so E is seen, not passed
summary: Fresh seed 9 (192^2, T=600) of world.py and world_starve.py (identical to t=300). From the noisy bath, amphiphile blobs at t~24 turn into multilamellar vesicles by t~150 with catalyst beads along their bilayers; four persist to t=600, all carrying K (kbodies_seed9.txt: 4 K-bearing bodies, 0 K-free, bilayer area 4464 -> 4879 px). labkit radial: K rim/core 3.61, rim/outside 2.69, 15/23 membrane-like; u itself 1.40 (5/23). After the feed cut at t=300 the catalyst collapses within ~50 t (total K 5796 -> 266) and the bilayer area falls 4615 -> 925 px by t=600 while the fed twin holds 4879; but 3 of the 4 bodies are still present at t=600 as small rings, 2 of them now K-free.

observations.S: rerun/seed9/sheet.png t=0: noise over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun/seed9/sheet.png t=150-600: four discrete multilamellar vesicles at fixed positions and near-constant size
observations.B: rerun/seed9/FACTS.md radial: catalyst K rim/core 3.61, rim/outside 2.69, 15/23 membrane-like; white K beads on the bilayers in sheet.png

seeds_run.result: starve fork at t=300: shrink 80%, 3/4 bodies alive at t=600

not_checked: E as passed: individuals did not die within 300 t of the cut
verdicts.limitation: E is seen but not passed on this seed: starving vesicles lose ~80% of bilayer and their catalyst, yet 3 of 4 are still present 300 t after the cut (2 of them K-free), so the fork shows decline, not death; it also holds largely by construction (amphiphile made only by K from P, decaying at kap). The bilayer's own u rim/core is 1.40; the layer that passes the gate is the catalyst. No division.
